value.rationale: One-hub compound-symmetry covariance/Hessian matrices are an infinite natural family where equilibration heuristics do not automatically optimize condition number. The theorem yields a closed-form globally optimal diagonal preconditioner, a sharp active-eigenspace phase boundary, a necessary-and-sufficient Jacobi-optimality criterion and an exact dimension-dependent scale-saturation law. This is a structural complete classification with genuine numerical-conditioning motivation rather than a small numerical improvement or unmotivated finite slice.
